Portrait setting: A flat concrete rooftop in Hosu at night. Behind the character, a round steel water tank on legs and a row of air-conditioning units stand before a waist-high parapet topped by a chain-link fence; beyond, neighboring rooftops of uneven height step away into a dense skyline of mid-rise buildings with scattered lit windows. A stairwell housing with a caged floodlight on its wall stands to one side of the character. A low haze over the streets holds the city's orange glow. No other people. No readable signs or text.

Scenery only: the choice does not move the character, grant access or affiliation, or supply props. Respect the selected frame and keep exactly one foreground character.
